extracted.intended_audience: public relations, communications, investor_relations, and marketing professionals (PR Newswire members and customers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and evaluative criteria for producing and measuring effective press releases and PR/communications campaigns across online, multimedia, and international channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of strong communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The principles of strong communications haven’t changed, but the way campaigns are executed is evolving in the new media age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that core communications principles remain constant even as interactive media and new channels change execution; success rules are still emerging and practitioners should adapt strategies to new media dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of Knowledge Center: actionable PR guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of the Knowledge Center is to offer public relations advice and strategies, how-to articles, thought leadership pieces and other information to help you make your public relations, investor relations, marketing and multimedia broadcast campaigns more effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Knowledge Center resources for practical, improvement-oriented guidance across PR, investor relations, marketing and multimedia broadcast; prioritize materials that directly help make campaigns more effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why Your Brand Needs a Voice on Twitter
rubrics_metrics.description: At any given moment, there are millions of conversations taking place on the... (article title: 'Why Your Brand Needs a Voice on Twitter').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain an active, branded presence on Twitter to participate in relevant conversations; treat social platforms as essential channels for brand voice and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Release SEO: Writing Press Releases Effectively for Search Engines
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand how search engine optimization works & take advantage of Press... (article title: 'Press Release SEO: Writing Press Releases Effectively for Search Engines').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compose press releases with search visibility in mind—use SEO best practices for headlines, keywords, and distribution so releases can be found and indexed by search engines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximize Your PR Budget for International Communication
rubrics_metrics.description: No matter what your budget is, it is essential to make every PR dollar... (article title: 'Maximize Your PR Budget for International Communication').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allocate and prioritize spend to achieve the greatest impact in international markets; adapt tactics and media mix to local markets to stretch budget effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpreting press release results with Visibility Reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpreting your press release results with PR Newswire’s Visibility Reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use distribution and visibility metrics to evaluate performance of releases; review reports to understand reach, pick channels that worked, and refine future targeting and messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of multimedia and specialized release formats (Photo, Flex Release™, MNR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Knowledge Center Items. FAQs: Photo; FAQs: Flex Release™; FAQs: MNR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage multimedia (images, video) and specialized release formats when appropriate; consult FAQs to understand format-specific best practices and when each option increases engagement or coverage.
